preamble.summary: Psalm 18 — David's psalm of deliverance, paralleled at 2 Sam 22 with significant textual differences. 8QPs preserves portions; tracks MT.
preamble.notable_variants: Parallel at 2 Sam 22 with documented textual differences. No significant content variants. Minor orthographic variation only (the standard Qumran plene-spelling tendency).
preamble.scroll_condition: Fragmentary attestation; no continuous DSS coverage.
